key_impacts: At least 2,000 premature deaths in the UK
evidence_snippets: The August 2003 heat wave resulted in at least 2,000 premature deaths in the UK alone.
Occurred during a summer with UK temperatures ~2°C above 1961–1990 average.
The flooding in the summer of 2007 caused flooding of 55,000 properties.
It left 350,000 people without mains water.
